name: FEMBOY FUTA DATE HOUSE
source: FEMBOY FUTA DATE HOUSE – A provocative visual novel set in a mysterious mansion filled with ten unique contestants. Shape the narrative through your choices, forge deep connections, and uncover the truth behind this glittering world.
translation: 《伪娘扶他约会大宅》（FEMBOY FUTA DATE HOUSE）——一款大胆撩人的视觉小说，舞台设在一座聚集了十位个性鲜明参赛者的神秘豪宅之中。通过你的选择塑造剧情走向，缔结深厚羁绊，揭开这个璀璨浮华世界背后的真相。
